messages:
Alex Rivera: Heads-up 8: ACME wants to move 40 seats from team 'platform-dev' -> 'platform-ops' and asks for a 10% early renewal discount if signed by 2024-12-10. They also want prorated credit for the moved seats through 2025-06-30. Need billing + legal + onboarding.
Nia Shah: 10% is borderline but might be acceptable if they sign for a 12-month renewal and reissue PO to the correct billing entity. What's the current annualized value on those 40 seats?
Alex Rivera: Current seat price is $45/mo on an annual contract. Those 40 seats = $21,600 ARR.
Omar Khan: Legal: we need an amendment and a clear effective date. I'll draft a one-paragraph amendment with prorate calc and "no further concessions" language. Please confirm whether credit is invoice adjustment or refund.
Sophie Tran: Onboarding: seat move requires SSO group remap and user reassignment. I can run the migration script but need final CSV with the 40 users and a maintenance window (30 mins).
Alex Rivera: Customer prefers invoice credit applied on next billing cycle. PO will reference INV-7012 per their procurement.
finance-bot: Provisional credit estimate created: CREDIT-177765-ACME (link: https://billing.internal/credit/CREDIT-177765). Calculation used: credit = seat_price * remaining_days / 365.
Nia Shah: If they sign by 2024-12-10 we can approve 10% discount on the renewed term. Confirming we require signed PO and DocuSign by that date.
Omar Khan: Draft addendum uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/addenda/acme-seat-move-amendment_draft.docx

Include snippet for prorate formula in clause:

```
Credit = $45 * remaining_days / 365 * 40
Applied as invoice adjustment on next cycle referencing INV-7012
```

Add clause: "Execution of this amendment constitutes full settlement of any credit claims related to the moved seats."
Sophie Tran: Please send CSV to onboarding@redwood.com and put "ACME-seat-move-40" in subject. I'll schedule the migration for 2024-12-02 02:00 UTC unless you request otherwise.
Alex Rivera: I'll request PO tonight and route DocuSign to renewals@acme.com cc:legal@redwood.com. Target signature 2024-12-08. :thumbsup:
